t: A dual-core Infineon chip family known for touch sensing and secure IoT.
steps: Buy a CY8CKIT-062S2-AI or CY8CPROTO-063-BLE kit from DigiKey or another distributor.
Get a USB cable that fits your kit and carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the Infineon PSoC 6 board package using the link in the Arduino core guide.
Pick your kit and its port from the menus.
Open the Blink example and press Upload.
Try a sensor example next and watch the readings in the Serial Monitor.
Explore ModusToolbox later for touch and security features.
meta: Open Code. From $17.40. A few stores.
